market_name: Will 12 or more Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether 2y/10y Treasury yields are falling and Fed funds futures (SOFR) are repricing dovishly; confirm the prediction-market move is not a stale/illiquid print.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move to intraday yield curve; verify no offsetting hawkish Fed speak or strong data release driving the opposite.
time_plan.2h: Reassess if rates futures sustain the dovish shift or mean-revert; watch for recession-signal corroboration in credit spreads (HYG).
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether the move is holding into the US session; check for scheduled Fed/Treasury events.
time_plan.12h: Mark final TLT return vs. entry; judge whether the prediction-market signal led the bond move or was noise.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 12+ Fed cuts in 2026 (300bps of easing) is a deep-recession / emergency-easing signal. Such a repricing of the rate path lower would pull front-end and long-end yields down, pushing long-duration bond prices up. TLT is the most liquid direct proxy for falling long-term yields.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY direction and real yields (TIPS); confirm gold is rising in sympathy with a dovish repricing.
time_plan.1h: Verify move isn't driven by an unrelated dollar/geopolitical shock; compare to silver and miners for confirmation.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether the dovish narrative persists or the prediction market reverts.
time_plan.6h: Monitor for US data/Fed headlines that could override the signal.
time_plan.12h: Record final GLD return and assess whether crisis-easing thesis was supported.

predictions.reasoning: Twelve cuts implies either a crisis demanding emergency easing or a hard pivot to very loose policy — both lower real yields and weaken the dollar, which are the classic tailwinds for gold. Gold benefits from both the risk-off (crisis) and the easing (lower real rates) interpretations, making it a cleaner directional proxy than equities, whose sign is ambiguous.

evidence_used: Market question: probability of 12+ (300bps) Fed cuts in 2026, an extreme tail easing scenario
Standard macro transmission: aggressive expected Fed easing lowers yields, weakens USD, supports gold and long bonds
Liquidity of TLT and GLD as clean rate/real-yield proxies
uncertainty_notes: 12+ cuts is a very low base-rate tail; a probability move may reflect thin, illiquid speculation rather than genuine information
Equities are directionally ambiguous — easing supports valuations but the implied crisis would hurt earnings/risk appetite, so no clean equity call
12h horizon is far too short for a 2026-dated macro market to drive a 700bps move in any liquid proxy, so these are not 'tradable' under the threshold

llm_justification.summary: The market prices the odds of an extreme 300bps (12-cut) Fed easing in 2026. A sharp rise in that probability signals deep-recession or emergency-easing expectations, which map most cleanly to lower long-term yields (TLT up) and higher gold (GLD up) via lower real rates and a weaker dollar. Equity direction is genuinely ambiguous, so no equity call is made. Confidence is low and expected 12h magnitudes are well below the 700bps tradable threshold.
key_assumptions: A probability move in this market reflects genuine shift in rate-path expectations, not illiquid noise
Dovish repricing transmits normally to yields, USD, and gold
No dominant offsetting shock (hawkish data, geopolitical USD bid) during the window
failure_modes: The prediction-market move is already public/priced into rates, so no residual asset move
Thin Polymarket liquidity produces a spurious probability swing with no real information
A 'crisis' interpretation could drive a USD safe-haven bid that pushes gold the other way, breaking the gold call
12h window is too short for a long-dated macro market to move liquid proxies meaningfully — below tradable threshold
Equity proxy omitted because sign is indeterminate; any directional equity bet would be manufactured
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
